en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large, ornate building with a tower, bay windows, and balconies surrounded by trees. The lower-case text on the front reads 'Bad Pyrmont' (lower left) and 'Liborius Haus' (lower right). The reverse side contains handwritten German text, a green 6 pfennig Deutsches Reich postage stamp with a man's profile, and printed and written addresses including 'Bad Pyrmont'.
